model: Binary equimolar ideal-gas feed:p_A=p_B=P_total/2. Each site family has a shared competitive capacity q_s,and q_i=sum_s q_s*b_si*p_i/(1+b_sA*p_A+b_sB*p_B). Families do not interact and the supplied constants are exact. Mixture selectivity S_A_over_B=(q_A/q_B)/(p_A/p_B),which here equals q_A/q_B. For a PURE-component comparison,omit the absent component from each site denominator and use the same numerical pressure p=1bar for the present component.
target: Return mixture A-over-Bselectivity at each listed total pressure,all strictly positive total pressures where mixture selectivity equals1,and which component is preferred at each listed pressure. Return the ratio of pure-Ato pure-Bloadings at p=1bar each,and report whether that pure-component ratio equals the actual mixture selectivity at total pressure2bar.
